correctness.rationale: The necessity proof uses a color-preserving cluster automorphism for repeated within-cluster patterns and a bisimulation relating a color in adjacent palettes when S_i is contained in S_(i+1). For sufficiency, the witness c_i in S_i\S_(i+1) defines suffixes inductively using T_(i+1)=not Diamond(chi_(c_i) and not T_(i+2)); these tails isolate each cluster, then each injected color isolates its unique world. The right-to-left palette counting has q choose a_h choices and for each step q choose a_i minus a_(i+1) choose a_i; each palette contributes a_i! world color assignments. Strictly positive factors yield q_* and ceiling log_2 q_* including r=0, one-world boundary. Independently recomputed small-coloring refinement, singleton generation and palette counts; universal proof does not rest on finite enumeration.
